title: MAP Sensor Low Voltage
shortDescription: Manifold absolute pressure sensor signal too low.
fullDescription: Indian Thunder Stroke ECU detects MAP signal below threshold. Affects fueling on Chief, Roadmaster, and Challenger models.

title: Engine Coolant Temp Low
fullDescription: Indian liquid-cooled models report ECT short to ground.

faq.a: Yes ECU adds fuel for cold engine assumption.

title: O2 Sensor Lean Front Cylinder
fullDescription: Indian Thunder Stroke front cylinder O2 sensor reports lean condition continuously.

faq.a: After-market exhaust often triggers this if not retuned.

title: Front Injector Circuit
fullDescription: Indian ECM detects front cyl injector circuit fault. Misfire on that cylinder.

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor
fullDescription: Indian Thunder Stroke or PowerPlus engine no-start due to CKP fault.

fixSteps.title: Replace CKP
fixSteps.instruction: Install new sensor on engine case.

faq.a: Yes a typical no-start cause on aging bikes.

title: Front Coil Primary Circuit
fullDescription: Indian ECM detects front coil primary circuit fault.

title: EVAP System Malfunction
fullDescription: Indian US-spec EVAP system detected leak or malfunction.

fixSteps.title: Tighten gas cap
fixSteps.instruction: Cycle gas cap and clear codes.

title: Vehicle Speed Sensor
fullDescription: Indian VSS signal lost. Speedo/cruise control affected.

faq.a: Wheel sensors are separate but may also flag.

title: ECM Communication Fault
fullDescription: Indian ECM cannot communicate with body control module. Various features disabled.

faq.a: Sometimes; depends on which features fail.

title: ABS Front Wheel Sensor
shortDescription: Front wheel speed sensor signal fault.
fullDescription: Indian ABS module reports front wheel sensor fault. ABS disabled.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Check front wheel sensor and harness.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new front wheel speed sensor.

faq.a: Yes but ABS is off; brake carefully.
